title: Owala FreeSip Stainless Steel Water Bottle 24 oz Out of the Blue

reviews.title: Keeps Drinks Cold All Day!
reviews.body: I absolutely love this Owala FreeSip bottle! It keeps my water ice cold for hours, even on long days. The FreeSip lid is one of my favorite features because I can sip through the built-in straw or take a regular drink from the spout without changing lids.The bottle is durable, easy to carry, and fits perfectly in my car’s cup holder. It’s also leakproof, so I never worry about spills in my bag. The matte black finish looks sleek and cleans up easily.If you’re looking for a high-quality insulated water bottle that keeps drinks cold and is comfortable to use every day, I highly recommend this one! It’s worth every penny.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 18, 2026
reviews.author: L.Mitchell

reviews.title: Incredible bottle at a reasonable price
reviews.body: The hype is real. Owala makes a durable and versatile water bottle that’s also sleek and easy to carry around. The only thing that this bottle cannot do is carry carbonated drinks or hot drinks (which I would assume is due to pressure causing the cap to fail). I have had no leaks while using my water bottle at home, in the car, and at work. I appreciate the size of this bottle because it has a smaller footprint than other bottles and fits well in most cup holders. While I’m not a big cold drink enjoyer I have noticed that my drinks stay cool for a good few hours. I really enjoy being able to sip or chug my drinks whenever I feel. It can be a little top heavy when low in content which will cause tip overs.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 9, 2026
reviews.author: Jacob

reviews.title: Best water bottle to exist!
reviews.body: If you have been debating on whether or not to get this water bottle, do not hesitate any longer! This water bottle is seriously the best one on the market right now. The temperature retention on these are seriously impressive- I went to the beach in 92 degree weather and left it sitting in the sun and by the end of the day some of the ice had still not melted! Is 100% leak proof, relatively lightweight considering the amazing material, and has the perfect handle to make transportation easy. ALSO, you can either use the straw, or drink out of it without the straw which is so cool. Plus the detachable straw makes it super easy to clean. Owala will forever and always be my favorite water bottle brand<3.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on July 14, 2026
reviews.author: Sophia Howell

reviews.title: Stylish and Functional
reviews.body: I've been really happy with this bottle. The FreeSip lid makes it easy to either sip through the straw or drink normally, and it keeps my water cold for hours. It's well made, easy to carry, and the Red Black Cherry color looks great. Definitely a great everyday water bottle.

reviews.title: Keeps Drinks Cold and Is Easy to Carry
reviews.body: I’ve been very happy with this Owala FreeSip bottle. The design is practical, and I really like the option to sip through the built-in straw or drink from the wide opening. It feels sturdy, is comfortable to carry, and keeps my drinks cold for hours. The lid closes securely, so I don’t have to worry about leaks. Overall, it’s a well-made bottle and a great choice for everyday use.

reviews.title: Pretty good, but rubber ring doesn't stay put
reviews.body: This is a nice water bottle with good functionality - keeps water cold, ergonomic to hold while drinking and carrying, and the push button makes drinking one-handed easy. Colors are really nice!Dinged one star because the rubber ring inside the lid does not stay put. This is a critical piece to retain temp and prevent dripping.

reviews.author: Viola

reviews.title: Best Water Bottle I’ve Ever Owned — Perfect Mix of Function, Durability, and Style
reviews.body: I’ve gone through plenty of water bottles over the years, and the Owala FreeSip is easily the best one I’ve used.The lid functionality is the standout feature. The push-button opening is smooth and secure, and the lock gives real peace of mind when tossing it into a bag. I love the dual drink design—being able to sip through the built-in straw or tilt back for a larger drink makes it incredibly convenient depending on what I’m doing.The material quality is excellent. The insulated stainless steel feels solid and premium, and it keeps drinks cold for hours on end. It has that durable, well-built feel without being overly heavy.In terms of versatility, this bottle just works everywhere—gym, car, travel, work, or outdoors. The dual-spout design makes it adaptable for quick hydration or longer sipping sessions, which honestly replaces the need for multiple bottles.The durability has been impressive. It’s held up well to daily use, bumps, and a few accidental drops without any major dents or performance issues. It really feels built to last.The size options are also great. I went with a mid-size, and it’s the sweet spot—large enough to last through the day but still easy to carry and fits in most cup holders and bags without being bulky.Finally, the appearance is honestly better than expected. The color options are clean and modern, and the matte finish gives it a sleek look that doesn’t feel like a typical “sports bottle.” It actually looks good sitting on a desk or in a car.Overall, this bottle nails the balance of function, durability, and design. Easily a 5-star product I’d buy again without hesitation.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on May 19, 2026
reviews.author: F.G.

features: 24-ounce insulated stainless-steel water bottle with a FreeSip spout and push-button lid with lock
Patented FreeSip spout designed for either sipping upright through the built-in straw or tilting back to swig from the spout opening
Protective push-to-open lid keeps spout clean; convenient carry loop doubles as a lock
Double-wall insulation keeps drinks cold for up to 24 hours; wide opening for cleaning and adding ice; cup holder-friendly base
BPA, lead, and phthalate-free; hand wash cup, dishwasher-safe lid; not for use with hot liquids
